name: Graham Crackers
siboNotes: Contains wheat-derived fructans which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Limit to small portions and avoid during SIBO flares.
preparationTips: Choose plain graham crackers over honey-sweetened varieties to reduce fructose load
Crush into small amounts for recipes rather than eating whole crackers
Pair with low-FODMAP proteins or fats to slow digestion
Check ingredient lists for added inulin or chicory root fiber
alternatives: Gluten-free crackers made from rice or corn
nutritionalHighlights: Contains some iron from wheat flour
